correctness.rationale: On the implication-only algebra I_n=P([n]) minus ∅ (n≥2), A⇒B=([n]\A)∪B, join is term-definable by (A⇒B)⇒B. Existing nonempty intersections are definable inside Boolean intervals [C,[n]] using relative complement and are preserved. The coordinate filter I_j={i:j∈F({i})}, nonempty by F([n])=[n], must be a singleton or all [n]: a proper filter with at least two elements would violate preservation of {s,u}∩{t,u}={u}. Thus every F uniquely is Fθ(A)={j:θ(j)=0 or θ(j)∈A}, with θ:[n]∪{0}→itself, θ(0)=0, and θ|[n] either permutation or taking 0 at least once; the converse preserves implication coordinatewise. For nonunit θ, with r distinct occupied nonzero symbols, image is the Boolean cube on r nonzero preimage blocks above nonempty fixed bottom θ^{-1}(0), so rank 2^r. Units have rank 2^n−1. Surjection count is binom(n,r)(r+1)!S(n,r+1), total (n+1)^n−n^n+n!. Idempotency θ²=θ gives binom(n,r)[(r+1)^(n−r)−r^(n−r)], plus one identity unit. Fresh independent complete pointed-map enumeration for n=2,3,4 matched ranks {1:1,2:4,3:2}, {1:1,2:18,4:18,7:6}, {1:1,2:56,4:216,8:96,15:24}, with idempotent totals 4,14,64. This is corroboration of a full-n proof.
